name: contact.pick
description: Given one person at a target company (title, tenure, shared history with the candidate, recent activity), judge whether they are the right first door for this role. Rank across candidates.

hm_likelihood.instructions: This person is likely the hiring manager or the hiring manager's direct leader for the role described

recruiter_for_req.instructions: This person is the recruiter or talent partner who would own this requisition

warm_strength.instructions: Strength of the warm path between the candidate and this person
criteria: 2nd degree through a strong mutual or shared past employer
1st degree, has interacted in the last year

responsive.instructions: This person posts, comments or replies publicly often enough that a message is likely to be read

rules.reason: strong warm path -- ask for the intro here first

notes: Created 2026-09-18 for Project Get a Job. Advisory until labelled.
